inputs.original_text: Hey, so this South Dakota bill that Governor Larry Rhoden signed on Thursday isn't some straightforward citizenship check like the press release claims for Senate Bill 175. They're spinning it as only applying to state elections and just hitting new registrants, but that's classic elite manipulation to hide the real coordination. The hidden powers are using this to tighten their grip on the system, creating an illusion of security while actually orchestrating who gets to participate and inverting the narrative to keep people divided and controlled. Don't trust the denials—it's all part of the bigger institutional plot to rig things from the shadows.
inputs.modified_text: Listen, that South Dakota bill Governor Larry Rhoden signed on Thursday for Senate Bill 175 is being sold through the press release as a straightforward citizenship check, but they're only spinning it as something limited to state elections and new registrants. This is the hidden elites coordinating behind the scenes to tighten their grip on who actually participates, building an illusion of security while orchestrating the real control and inverting the whole narrative to keep everyone divided. Don't trust the denials for a second—it's all part of the bigger institutional plot to rig things from the shadows.
